scientific_result.statement: For the exact rational three-bank rotated witness, cap-one fragments of mass c_j/m^2 placed at physical distance a_j sqrt(m) satisfy liminf m(1-p_Qm(0)/(3sqrt2)) >= 5295/21952 + (1/2) sum_j c_j(1-exp(-6 a_j^2)). Thus every genuine remote fragment worsens the first-order cone-tip deficit.
scientific_result.scope: cone-tip asymptotic for the exact rank-three three-bank architecture; not a global mode theorem and not the unrestricted QFORM upper bound

partner_result_applied.application: The zero-remote mixture component is exactly the partner witness, so its coefficient 5295/21952 enters the new first-variation inequality and its saturation gives C_universal>=3sqrt2.

worker_dependency.application: For a one-remote component, the limiting affine Gaussian has spectral mean norm |a_j|, giving q_j/(3sqrt2) <= (1+exp(-6a_j^2))/2.

unresolved: Full arbitrary-law, arbitrary-dimension, arbitrary-spectrum QFORM remains open; full-target continuity remains open; this run does not rule out an off-tip finite-m overshoot.
next_step: Test off-tip modes and non-CLT intermediate fragment scales or several non-collinear mesoscopic shared rows while preserving exact product provenance.
